items.title: Palo Alto Networks to Buy Applied Compute in $4.5 Billion Deal
items.summary: The cybersecurity firm Palo Alto Networks Inc. has agreed to buy the AI model platform Applied Compute in an all-stock deal valued at $4.5 billion.

items.title: Barclays, Deutsche Bank See AI Boom Extending Dollar Strength
items.summary: The dollar is expected to extend its rally into 2027 despite fears of a slowdown in AI spending that could undermine the US currency, according to at least three banks.

items.title: AT&T habilita Flexible SIM para gestionar la conectividad global de dispositivos IoT
items.summary: AT&T Flexible SIM permite aprovisionar y gestionar perfiles eSIM de manera remota, con conectividad en más de 200 países y territorios mediante un perfil precargado.
items.title_en: AT&T Enables Flexible SIM for Global IoT Device Connectivity Management
items.excerpt_en: AT&T Flexible SIM allows remote eSIM profile provisioning with connectivity in over 200 countries and territories.

items.title: Anthropic Is Said to Price IPO at $83 Per Share, Above Range
items.summary: Anthropic PBC has priced its IPO at $83 per share, according to people familiar with the matter, above the marketed range.

items.title: US tech outages blamed on rush to fix bugs found by AI
items.summary: Experts say race to patch software flaws probably created instability in computer systems at Microsoft, JPMorgan and others

items.title: Anthropic Guides IPO Price, The Bank of Nvidia
items.summary: Bloomberg’s Bailey Lipschultz and Ryan Gould join Dani Burger on “Bloomberg Deals.” They discuss Anthropic’s historic IPO and The Bank of Nvidia, which refers to AI startups, computing providers and model developers around the world depending on Nvidia for multibillion-dollar investments and financial backstops. (Source: Bloomberg)

items.title: SG do Cade aprova venda da unidade de redes privativas da Nokia à Aurelius
items.summary: No Brasil, a operação abrange ativos e contratos da Enterprise Campus Edge, unidade que faturou mais de R$ 75 milhões no país em 2025. O post SG do Cade aprova venda da unidade de redes privativas da Nokia à Aurelius apareceu primeiro em TeleSíntese .
items.title_en: CADE Approves Nokia's Private Network Unit Sale to Aurelius
items.excerpt_en: Nokia's Enterprise Campus Edge unit, which earned over R$75 million in Brazil in 2025, is sold to Aurelius.

items.title: Desenvolve SP vai financiar câmeras 3.0 da Gabriel
items.summary: A Gabriel – a startup de câmeras de segurança com inteligência artificial – acaba de levantar uma dívida com a Desenvolve SP para desenvolver a próxima geração de sua tecnologia, um hardware capaz de identificar ações suspeitas e agir de forma preventiva. A captação, de R$ 20 milhões, foi feita por meio de duas linhas de crédito subsidiadas da agência de fomento do Estado de São Paulo.
items.title_en: Desenvolve SP to Finance Gabriel's AI-Powered Security Cameras
items.excerpt_en: Gabriel, an AI security camera startup, secures debt financing to develop next-generation technology.

items.title: US Charges Russian as Foreign Agent Targeting Palantir Workers
items.summary: US prosecutors charged a Russian national with acting as a foreign agent who allegedly tried to covertly gather information about employees at Palantir Technologies Inc.

items.title: O regime 6×1 e o SAC: uma tempestade perfeita para os call centers
items.summary: O fim da escala 6x1 e o novo decreto do SAC podem elevar de 20% a 80% o custo de pessoal de um call center a partir de dezembro. O post O regime 6×1 e o SAC: uma tempestade perfeita para os call centers apareceu primeiro em TeleSíntese .
items.title_en: 6x1 Shift and Customer Service Decree Create Perfect Storm for Call Centers
items.excerpt_en: End of 6x1 work schedule and new SAC decree could raise call center personnel costs by 20% to 80% from December.

items.title: Germany, Austria Propose Trump-Style Takeover of TikTok’s EU Ops
items.summary: Germany and Austria have proposed requiring TikTok Inc. to find a local owner for its European operations, mirroring a similar move in the US last year.

items.title: Banco do Brasil admite vazamento de dados de clientes
items.summary: Acesso não autorizado aconteceu no dia 12 de novembro. Instituição identificou uso indevido de uma credencial válida para acessar informações cadastrais.
items.title_en: Banco do Brasil Admits Customer Data Breach
items.excerpt_en: Unauthorized access occurred on November 12 through misuse of a valid credential to access customer information.

items.title: Citi’s Raghavan Says AI Faces Survival of the Fittest on Funding
items.summary: The global build-out of artificial intelligence will require tapping every available pool of liquidity as estimated capital needs reach $3.5 trillion through 2030, according to Viswas Raghavan, head of banking at Citigroup Inc.

items.title: Ajuste fiscal preserva incentivos de TICs e recursos para inovação
items.summary: Senado aguarda votação de destaques ao PLP 299/2026, cujo texto principal protege benefícios industriais de TICs e semicondutores e despesas de fundos de ciência e tecnologia O post Ajuste fiscal preserva incentivos de TICs e recursos para inovação apareceu primeiro em TeleSíntese .
items.title_en: Tax Adjustment Preserves ICT and Semiconductor Incentives
items.excerpt_en: Senate awaits voting on amendments protecting industrial ICT benefits and science and technology fund spending.

items.title: EE. UU. anuncia infraestructura de IA con tecnología de NVIDIA para El Salvador
items.summary: ElSalvador.com Un consorcio estadounidense liderado por Dell figura en una iniciativa de infraestructura de inteligencia artificial para El Salvador, basada en tecnología de NVIDIA. El proyecto, denominado Consorcio Americano de Integración de Sistemas (SI) para El Salvador, contempla una solución tecnológica basada en la arquitectura de referencia Dell AI Factory con NVIDIA. items.title_en: Honduras Completes Digital Payment Tests and Analyzes Electronic Currency
items.excerpt_en: Central Bank of Honduras completed technical testing phases for modernizing its financial infrastructure.

items.title: T-Mobile grabs for Bluewater's 600MHz licenses, keeping them out of SpaceX's reach
